definition_english: Pertaining to, framed as, or subsisting strictly as an abstract mental conception, general proposition, or theoretical construct rather than concrete empirical particularity or lived realization.
definition_hindi: मूर्त अनुभवजन्य विशिष्टता या वास्तविक अनुभूति के स्थान पर केवल अमूर्त मानसिक अवधारणा, सामान्य प्रतिज्ञप्ति या सैद्धांतिक संरचना से संबंधित अथवा उसी रूप में विद्यमान।

etymology.root_language: Latin (via Middle English and Medieval Latin)
forms: Greek ennoia / prolēpsis (loan-translation source by Cicero)
etymology.historical_development: Formed from notion + -al (Latin -ālis). Earlier Middle English nocional dates to the late 14th century from Medieval Latin notionalis; modern notional (pertaining to a notion, theoretical, speculative) is attested in the 1590s (first known use 1597 in Merriam-Webster). In 19th-century epistemology, John Henry Newman opposed notional assent to real assent.

register_and_pragmatics.academic_register: High scholarly and philosophical Tatsama register
register_and_pragmatics.connotation: Neutral-abstract; contrasts intellectual apprehension of general propositions with concrete empirical realization
cultural_nuances: English connects philosophical abstraction, derivative face values, and service-law deeming under one root (notion), whereas Hindi splits these domains across distinct adjectives.
usage_restrictions: Do not use अवधारणात्मक in payroll, taxation, or financial derivative contracts.
Avoid काल्पनिक in philosophical prose where it activates colloquial connotations of unreal or fabricated (फ़र्ज़ी/मनगढ़ंत).
Reject unattested or erroneous dictionary glosses such as अभियात्मक and छिद्रान्वेषी.

linguistic_analysis.morphosyntax: English notional is a gradable adjective in S1 (more/most notional) occurring both attributively and predicatively. Hindi अवधारणात्मक is an invariable Sanskrit tatsama adjective formed via vowel sandhi of अवधारणा + आत्मक.
linguistic_analysis.cross_linguistic_tradeoff: Rendering S1 with अवधारणात्मक or सैद्धांतिक preserves philosophical precision but sacrifices the cross-domain lexical unity of English notional across law, finance, and linguistics.

conceptual_analysis.core_distinction: Contrasts intellectual acceptance of abstract propositions against forceful apprehension of concrete realities, as formulated in John Henry Newman's distinction between notional assent and real assent.
conceptual_analysis.domain_boundary: Distinct from S2 administrative/service-law paper progression, S3 financial/tax reference bases, and S4 semantic grammatical concord.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both denote non-concrete, abstract academic frameworks.
pairwise_comparison.difference: अवधारणात्मक anchors meaning in mental concepts (aligned with conceptual analysis), whereas सैद्धांतिक shifts focus toward doctrine or principle (सिद्धांत संबंधी) and better captures theoretical-versus-real contrast.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Partial; prefer अवधारणात्मक for concept-centered philosophical analysis and सैद्धांतिक when opposing abstract theory to concrete execution.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both derive from Sanskrit concept/notion nouns (अवधारणा and धारणा) with -आत्मक.
pairwise_comparison.difference: अवधारणात्मक is attested in IGNOU philosophy/logic coursework (अवधारणात्मक विश्लेषण), while धारणात्मक is primarily attested in linguistics and lexicography.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Moderate in general academic prose; prefer अवधारणात्मक in philosophy and धारणात्मक in linguistics.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both can describe non-empirical mental constructs.
pairwise_comparison.difference: काल्पनिक carries strong everyday connotations of imaginary, utopian, or fabricated (फ़र्ज़ी/मनगढ़ंत), distorting analytical philosophical propositions.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Not interchangeable in rigorous philosophical discourse.
